title: City of the Dead
order_note: Sorted by recording id: C (cinematics), M (in-engine cutscenes), T (gameplay transmissions); unit barks follow their trigger group. Interleaving of C/M/T is not confirmed.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: We Forsaken have only just begun to find our place in a world that reviles our very existence.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: There is no home for us, so we must build one for ourselves. And we must do so together.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: In the coming years, I will rely on your strength, Garek Bandarion. As will all the people of the Undercity.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: Are you prepared to serve them? To serve the Forsaken?

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: I... Yes. I am, Lady Sylvanas.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: Then I shall leave you to it.
lines.raw: ["Happy" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]Then I shall leave you to it.[/"Happy"]

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: Teach him well, Anya. There is much yet to be done.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Abomination
lines.text: Rend and tear!

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Putress
lines.text: Ah, you’ve returned. No hard feelings about before, I hope?

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: No, I suppose not.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: What do you want, Putress?

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Putress
lines.text: Oh, just a few odds and ends for my research. If you would be so kind.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: The Dark Lady has asked us to aid you, and so we will. Come, Garek.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Bernd
lines.text: Ah, it’s you! Thank you for saving me from the Scourge.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Bernd
lines.text: As you can see, Lady Sylvanas has already found a task for me. I was a mason in life, and now I can use those skills to build our city.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Bernd
lines.text: But I can’t do much without the stone from the nearby quarry, and it’s been overrun by ogres.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: So you want us to clear it out for you. Don’t worry. We’ll handle the ogres and get you what you need.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Varimathras
lines.text: This one is mine!

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Who, who are you?
lines.raw: ["Surprised" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]Who, who are you?[/"Surprised"]

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: This is the dreadlord Varimathras. Defector from the Scourge, now a servant of the Dark Lady.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Good of you to finally show up. Where have you been?

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Varimathras
lines.text: Investigating this incursion. The Scourge have been digging tunnels through the old catacombs.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Varimathras
lines.text: What you fought here was merely a scouting force. I command you to exterminate the rest of them.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: That may prove difficult for just the two of us.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Varimathras
lines.text: Then recruit more soldiers and form a city guard. Whatever your course of action, do it quickly. I am not as patient as Lady Sylvanas.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Their leader spoke of a cathedral. He must mean the one in the city’s ruins. I’ll wager that’s their base of operations.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: We’ll follow these tunnels, infiltrate the cathedral and kill whoever we find there.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The priest that was with these soldiers... he seemed to understand that the Forsaken differ from the Scourge.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Do you suppose, if we find him in the cathedral, that we can reason with him?

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Absolutely not. Never trust the living, Garek. They are the enemy.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: If you insist, Anya.
lines.raw: ["Squint" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]If you insist, Anya.[/"Squint"]

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Keever
lines.text: Putress has tasked Keever with assembling a new abomination. But we need another batch of parts.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Keever
lines.text: Apparently, the parts Keever was supposed to use woke up and started walking around.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Sorry to have inconvenienced you.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Keever
lines.text: Hmph. Keever has compiled a list of suitable replacements. Can you manage collecting them?

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: I suppose it’s the least I could do. Let’s have the list, then.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: Anya, Garek. You have done well bringing more Forsaken into the Undercity. As our population grows, so too do our chances at survival.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: Unfortunately, we have also become a larger target for those who seek to destroy us. Intruders have been spotted in the city’s canals.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: You are to poison the water supply with plague. Such toxins won’t harm the Forsaken, but will discourage the living from further trespassing.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: It will be done, Dark Lady.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Edric
lines.text: Hello? Who's there? I can't see without my eye!
lines.raw: ["Scared" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]Hello? Who's there? I can't see without my eye![/"Scared"]

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Edric? What are you doing down here?

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Edric
lines.text: Anya, is that you? I lost my one good eye and now I can’t find my way out of the sewers!

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Well, your chances of finding it are pretty slim. Stay here for now.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Keever
lines.text: Hmm. Do you believe ghouls are capable of sentience, despite the state of their cerebral matter?

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: This again, Keever? Ghouls are mindless beasts, driven only by hunger.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Keever
lines.text: A common assumption. One that Keever must prove or disprove.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Keever
lines.text: There are reports of ghouls nearby who exhibit unusual behavior. Bring them to Keever for observation.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Lexington
lines.text: Anya, Garek, I could very much benefit from your assistance.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Lexington
lines.text: You see, I recently discovered that hidden with the ruins of the Capital City is the entrance to an arcane vault.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Lexington
lines.text: I surmise that it may contain a powerful artifact once used by the Menethils' own royal mages.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Lexington
lines.text: I dare not brave the ruins myself, let along the vault. But if you were to do so for me...

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: We’ll see what we can do. But if this ends up being a wild goose chase, there will be hell to pay.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Laborer
lines.text: Spare me, please! I'm just a stonemason! I have nothing to do with the Scourge!
lines.raw: ["Scared" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]Spare me, please! I'm just a stonemason! I have nothing to do with the Scourge![/"Scared"]

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Brother Damien
lines.text: You... can speak? And your mind seems intact...
lines.raw: ["Surprised" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]You... can speak? And your mind seems intact...[/"Surprised"]

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Brother Damien
lines.text: Lord Francis, we must bring this man to General Abbendis. If some of the undead have truly broken away from the Scourge--

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Lord Francis
lines.text: General Abbendis’s orders were clear. The undead are to be eliminated. All of them.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Brother Damien
lines.text: Stop! What are you doing?!
lines.raw: ["Surprised" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]Stop! What are you doing?![/"Surprised"]

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Lord Francis
lines.text: Claiming vengeance for Lordaeron, Brother Damien. Now burn the corpse.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Brother Damien
lines.text: By the Light... if some of the undead can be saved...

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Lord Francis
lines.text: They are all monsters who deserve to be slain. And now we have a way into their foul lair.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Lord Francis
lines.text: With me, Damien. We must prepare for a full assault.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: Garek! Anya! You got a second?

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Not really...

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: Great! I could use some help.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: The Mechanical Engineering Guild of Azeroth hosts an open racing league, but my driver just blew himself up!

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: A racing league?
lines.raw: ["Surprised" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]A racing league?[/"Surprised"]

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: The fastest rides on wheels, all competing for first place. And I think you’ve got what it takes to win! I’ll even pay you!

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: All right, Glix. But this had better be quick.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: Hah! I was just about to say the same to you! Now let's get you buckled in.
lines.raw: ["Happy" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]Hah! I was just about to say the same to you! Now let's get you buckled in.[/"Happy"]

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: The race is being held in Silverpine. I'll provide the transportation, free of charge!

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission OQ AR Portal Q
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: The race is being held in Silverpine. I'll provide the transportation, free of charge!

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ Sec Ch Start Game Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: What is this place?

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ Sec Ch Start Game Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: We call it the Undercity, carved from the sewers and catacombs beneath Lordaeron’s fallen capital.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ Sec Ch Start Game Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: And to answer your earlier question, my name is Anya. Now follow me. You have much to learn.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ Sec Ch Questions Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: What happened to me? Am I... dead?

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ Sec Ch Questions Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Undead. We Forsaken are former thralls of the Lich King, newly freed by Lady Sylvanas Windrunner.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ Sec Ch Questions Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Whoever you were in life, you’re now one of us.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ Sec Ch Anya Altar Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Acquaint yourself with the Revival Altar. You’ll need it if you fall in battle.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ Sec Ch Anya Training Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Good. Now let’s gauge your combat skills by training with the guards.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ Sec Ch Guard Aggro01 Q
lines.speaker: Forsaken Guard
lines.text: Let’s see what you’ve got, newcomer.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ Sec Ch Guard Aggro02 Q
lines.speaker: Forsaken Guard
lines.text: Try not to fall too quickly.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ Sec Ch Guard Aggro03 Q
lines.speaker: Forsaken Guard
lines.text: Another recruit, Anya? This one better last longer.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ Sec Ch Guard Aggro04 Q
lines.speaker: Forsaken Guard
lines.text: I’ve been itching for a fight!

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ Sec Ch Guard Aggro05 Q
lines.speaker: Forsaken Guard
lines.text: Finally, something other than a ghoul!

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ Sec Ch Guard Aggro06 Q
lines.speaker: Forsaken Guard
lines.text: Rise and shine, rookie!

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ Sec Ch Anya Traps 01 Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: See that fire? It would be wise to let it do the fighting for us.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ Sec Ch Anya Package Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Well done. It seems you’ve retained more than just your name.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ Sec Ch Anya Package Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Come, we have more tasks to attend in the Trade Quarter.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ Sec Ch Elevator Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: My memories... will they ever return?

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ Sec Ch Elevator Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Perhaps, perhaps not. Each Forsaken experiences their awakening differently.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ Sec Ch Elevator Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Either way, your former life is gone. Remake yourself in undeath.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ Sec Ch Anya Money Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Fiona often has valuable supplies in stock. Here’s some coin for you to spend.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ Sec Ch Anya Sylvanas Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Once you’re done, come with me. There’s someone you should meet.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ FW Sylvanas Gives Quest Q
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: More undead awaken amidst the ruins. Bring these new Forsaken to the safety of the Undercity.

lines.scene: Research.Change Color of Portrait
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: More undead awaken amidst the ruins. Bring these new Forsaken to the safety of the Undercity.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ FW Return Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Seems lively down here. I suppose Sylvanas put everyone to work.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ FW Return Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: We must all do our part if we’re to make this city truly ours.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ FW Sylvanas Reward Q
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: Well done. The Undercity teems with new Forsaken.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ FW Sylvanas Direct to Putters Q
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: Grand Apothecary Putress was asking for you. I believe word of your skills is spreading fast.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ AS Gossiping About Putress Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: I take it you are not fond of Putress.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ AS Gossiping About Putress Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: His genius is undeniable. It’s his demeanor that leaves much to be desired.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ AS Gossiping About Putress Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Still, he has earned the Dark Lady’s trust, and so I do my best to tolerate him.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ AS Putress Reward Q
lines.speaker: Putress
lines.text: Ah, the reagents I requested. I trust they were not too troublesome to procure.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ AS Putress Direct to Bernd Q
lines.speaker: Putress
lines.text: By the way, the mason you rescued earlier requires your assistance. You’ll find him near the canal.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission OQ PC Chatting Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Plaguing the city’s water supply seems like an extreme measure.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission OQ PC Chatting Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Only the Forsaken call the Undercity home. Making it inhospitable is the perfect defense against the living.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission OQ PC Chatting Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Do the living hate us that much? We share a common enemy in the Scourge.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission OQ PC Chatting Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: As far as the living are concerned, the Forsaken and the Scourge are one and the same.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission OQ BF Eye Aquired Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Edric’s eye is a powerful magical trinket. One that he keeps misplacing.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission OQ BF Eye Aquired Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: We can return it to him and wait for him to lose it again, or we can equip it ourselves. Your choice.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission OQ PC Pour Poison Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Pour the poison here. The flow of water should carry it throughout the rest of the canals.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission OQ PC Garek Flashback 03 Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: There’s something familiar about these canals. Like I’ve been here before...

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission OQ PC Garek Flashback 03 Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Perhaps you were a sanitation worker in life.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission OQ PC Garek Flashback 03 Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It does feel like I had a reason to be down here... something important...

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission OQ BF Reward Q
lines.speaker: Edric
lines.text: Did you find my eye? Oh, thank the Dark Lady! I’d never find my way out of here without it!

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission OQ BF No Reward Q
lines.speaker: Edric
lines.text: My eye... how will I ever get out of here if I can’t see?

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission OQ PC Sylvanas Reward Q
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: Excellent work. The canals flow with plague, and the living will risk much in an attempted invasion.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission OQ SPQ Help Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Leave it to us. Better we play the hunter than the prey.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission OQ SPQ Giant Spider Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: That certainly is a gigantic spider.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission OQ SPQ Cut Mushrooms Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: We can’t reach it up there! Cut down the mushrooms!

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission OQ SPQ Reward Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Well done. Now our workers can continue building in peace.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission OQ AB Keever Reward Q
lines.speaker: Keever
lines.text: Hmm. These parts will suffice. At least you didn’t damage them. Much.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission OQ AB Keever Reward Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: You’re welcome, Keever.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ SQ Bernd Reward Q
lines.speaker: Bernd
lines.text: Shipments from the quarry are already coming in! I can’t thank you two enough. Please, accept this as a token of gratitude.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ SQ Bernd Direct to Excavation Q
lines.speaker: Bernd
lines.text: I hate to ask something of you again so soon, but one of my excavation crews hasn’t returned. Would you mind tracking them down?

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ SQ Bernd Direct to Excavation Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Sure. Mark the excavation site on our map and we’ll check it out.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ DD Corpses Found Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Anya, look! What is this--

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ DD Corpses Found Q
lines.speaker: Scourge Fanatic
lines.text: Slaughter these traitorous Forsaken!

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ DD Corpses Found Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: The Scourge!

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ DD Gareks Flashback 01 Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It’s... it’s happening again...

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ DD Gareks Flashback 01 Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Garek, what are you talking about?

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ SP Varimathras Hint Q
lines.speaker: Varimathras
lines.text: Recruit the forces you require from the mercenary camp. Once you have what you need, strike hard and fast.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ SP Gareks Flashback 02 Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: All this fighting...in the sewers, in the city... I can almost remember...

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ SP Gareks Flashback 02 Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Garek. This is not the time to ponder your lost memories. Focus on the here and now.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ SP Acolyte Flee Q
lines.speaker: Acolyte
lines.text: Intruders! They must not interfere with the master's plans!

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ SP Raise Dead Comment 01 Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: They’re raising the dead interred here to bolster their ranks.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ SP Raise Dead Comment 01 Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Can’t the Forsaken do the same?

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ SP Raise Dead Comment 01 Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: No. Only the Scourge possess the means to do that. We must rely on their control lapsing in order to recruit more to our side.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ SP Catacomb Event Trap Start Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We’re trapped! It’s an ambush!

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ SP Catacomb Event Trap Start Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Something is maintaining that barrier. Survive until it shows itself!

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ SP Catacomb Event Trap Complete Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The way is clear! Let’s move!

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ SP Landen Shield Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: This guardsman’s shield is pristine. He must have taken great pride in defending the city.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ SP Landen Shield Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Then it would be a shame to let his shield go to rust. Use it to protect the Forsaken.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ SP Boss Finished Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: That should be all of them. Let’s inform Varimathras that the catacombs are secure.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ SP Scrourge Discussion Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: To think such a large force could get this close to the Undercity...

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ SP Scrourge Discussion Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Many among both the living and dead want to exterminate the Forsaken. We must remain ever vigilant.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ SP Varimathras Reward Q
lines.speaker: Varimathras
lines.text: The Scourge had best think twice before trying that again. Take your reward.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ MF Varimathras Gives Quest Q
lines.speaker: Varimathras
lines.text: These workers were not the only ones to go missing. Another group has yet to return from the ventilation corridors.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ MF Varimathras Gives Quest Q
lines.speaker: Varimathras
lines.text: I want you to follow their trail. Begin in the Trade Quarter, where they were last seen.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission OQ GH Sewers Ghoul Spotted Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: That ghoul looks like one that Keever would want to study.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission OQ GH Keever Reward Q
lines.speaker: Keever
lines.text: Each ghoul showed signs of intelligence? Interesting. Keever can make use of this.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission OQ AV Reward Q
lines.speaker: Lexington
lines.text: Ah, this is perfect! I hope it wasn’t too difficult to retrieve. You have my sincerest gratitude.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission TQ Sewers Rats Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: No sign of the workers... and no guards, either. Only the rats.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission TQ Sewers Blocked Way Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: This path is blocked. We’ll need to find another way around.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission TQ Sewers Blocked Door Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: The gate is controlled by a pair of switches. It won’t open unless both are flipped simultaneously.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission TQ Sewers Burned Undead Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Well, we found the workers.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission TQ Sewers Burned Undead Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Their bodies were burned. Something is amiss.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission TQ Sewers Vocies Around Corner Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Quiet. I hear voices up ahead.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission TQ Sewers Kill Silverhand Intruders Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: The Knights of the Silver Hand. We have to get rid of them. Now!

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission TQ Sewers SH Door Need Keys Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: I see two keyholes. We’ll probably need both to open the door.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission TQ Sewers Who Are Silverhand Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Who are the Silver Hand?

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission TQ Sewers Who Are Silverhand Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Fanatics who worship the Holy Light. They see us as anathema and want to purge us from the world.

lines.scene: Traps.TQ Wall Trap Squeeze.MQ 08 Wall Trap Moment
lines.speaker: Silver Hand Footman
lines.text: The undead have found us! Seal the tunnel!

lines.scene: Traps.TQ Wall Trap Squeeze.MQ 08 Wall Trap Moment
lines.speaker: Silver Hand Footman
lines.text: No! Wait for me!

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission TQ Sewers Steam Room Trap Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: That water will boil us into mush. We need to turn off the heat.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission TQ Sewers Captain Taunt Q
lines.speaker: Lord Francis
lines.text: The undead have discovered us! They must not reach the cathedral!

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission TQ Sewers PONR Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: We should provision ourselves and recruit troops before proceeding. Once we enter the cathedral, there will be no turning back.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission TQ Sewers PONR Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Agreed. There may be citizens in the Undercity that still need our help, as well.

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission OQ SPQ Help Q
lines.speaker: Forsaken Citizen
lines.text: Anya, help! There’s a gigantic spider lurking in the caves!

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission OQ AR Reward Q
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: Nice driving, Garek. Here's your reward, as promised!

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ DD Deciever Warcry Q
lines.speaker: Scourge Fanatic
lines.text: Let blood drown the weak!

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission MQ DD Necro Warcry Q
lines.speaker: Necromancer
lines.text: Die!

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission OQ GH Sewers Ghoul Scared Q
lines.speaker: Crafty Ghoul
lines.text: Me scary!

lines.scene: Transmissions.Transmission OQ GH Sewers Ghoul Happy Q
lines.speaker: Crafty Ghoul
lines.text: Whazzup?

lines.scene: CINEMATICS.Cinematic Moment 03 - Scourge Boss Appears.Cinematic Moment 03 Play Q
lines.speaker: Death Knight
lines.text: For the Lich King!
